# Hide the retired APDR listing on skills.sh

I maintain [APDR](https://github.com/cuyedmundo/apdr). The repository was renamed from `cuyedmundo/analisis-preventivo-de-requerimientos` to `cuyedmundo/apdr`. The current skill ID is `apdr` and the GitHub source version is `2.2.0`.

Please hide `cuyedmundo/apdr/analisis-preventivo-de-requerimientos` from public search and directory pages. It still appeared in Skills.sh search on 2026-11-14, while its detail page said the skill was unavailable. The [former long-slug URL](https://www.skills.sh/cuyedmundo/analisis-preventivo-de-requerimientos/analisis-preventivo-de-requerimientos) now redirects to that unavailable page. If retired records under the old repository slug remain independently indexed, please hide those records as well.

Please keep [the current listing](https://www.skills.sh/cuyedmundo/apdr/apdr) and the existing redirect from the old repository's `/apdr` URL to it. The listing exposes the correct install command for `cuyedmundo/apdr`.

Please also refresh the existing `cuyedmundo/apdr/apdr` record from [commit `43df27a`](https://github.com/cuyedmundo/apdr/commit/43df27a6a625a28ca7a668faa530560054d080e9). On 2026-11-14, a fresh `npx skills add cuyedmundo/apdr --skill apdr` installed `2.2.0` with the TL;DR guidance and the `CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0` license, while the public detail and download still served `2.1.1`. Please refresh the rendered detail and stored `SKILL.md` and `LICENSE`, preserving the canonical slug and install history.
